steps.action: Add steps 1-4: recurring Obligation with Registration, Assignee, Matter and Note
steps.expected: The row shows the due date, recurrence and links.

The Matter list offered 33 reachable Matters and not the other role's Confidential Matter.

steps.action: Add step 2: a blank recurrence makes a one-off
steps.expected: The one-off row has no recurrence.
steps.actual: The one-off saved with due 2026-11-20 and no recurrence; its row read {"Due date":"Nov 20, 2026","Obligation":"DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L one-off licence","Repeat every (months)":"—","Registration":"—","Assignee":"Nadia Haddad","Matter":"—","Note":"—","col7":"","Actions":"Mark complete"}.

steps.action: Negative: recurrence outside 1 to 1,200 months and a blank Label are refused
steps.expected: 1201 and 0 keep the dialog open with a message; a blank Label does not submit; nothing is created.
steps.actual: Outcomes [{"months":"1201","open":true,"message":"One or more request fields are invalid."},{"months":"0","open":true,"message":"Value must be greater than or equal to 1."}]. A blank Label kept the dialog open ("Please fill out this field."). No bad-recurrence Obligation was stored.

steps.action: Add step 5: the menu beside Mark complete, Edit, Save changes; Cancel discards
steps.expected: Edit obligation saves the note with Save changes; a Cancelled assignee change is not stored.
steps.actual: Edit from the row menu opened "Edit obligation"; Save changes stored the note. A second Edit that chose Unassigned and then Cancel left the assignee Nadia Haddad. After a reload the row read {"Due date":"Nov 20, 2026","Obligation":"DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L one-off licence","Repeat every (months)":"—","Registration":"—","Assignee":"Nadia Haddad","Matter":"—","Note":"Renew before the end of November.","col7":"","Actions":"Mark complete"}.

steps.action: Restricted matter: a linked Matter outside your reach shows Restricted matter; editing keeps the link
steps.expected: The Matter cell reads Restricted matter with no number or title; Save changes keeps the stored link.
steps.actual: The row read {"Due date":"May 31, 2027","Obligation":"DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L restricted link","Repeat every (months)":"—","Registration":"—","Assignee":"Unassigned","Matter":"Restricted matter","Note":"—","col7":"","Actions":"Mark complete"}; neither the Matter title nor M-34 appeared. Edit obligation showed Matter "Restricted matter". After Save changes, Daniel Okafor's read still linked M-34.

steps.action: Column widths: drag a heading edge or use the arrow keys; the actions stay at the right; widths are remembered across Entity obligation tables in this browser
steps.expected: The Note column narrows by a drag on its edge and by ArrowLeft; the second Entity's table opens with the same width; Home resets it.
steps.actual: Note column width 151px. A drag that started on the edge line left it at 151px (hit test across the strip ["separator","separator","TH","TH","TH"]); a drag that started just left of the line narrowed it to 121px; ArrowLeft on the focused edge made it 105px. Mark complete stayed at the right of the table (right edge 1154, table end 1198). DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L second entity's table opened with the Note column at 105px; Home on the edge reset it to 153px.

steps.action: Calendar steps 1-2: Calendar, Due-date list puts overdue open Obligations first; Filter, Entity and Assignee, Apply
steps.expected: Overdue rows lead; the filter narrows to this Entity and assignee.
steps.actual: The unfiltered list had 8 overdue rows, all before the first open future row (of 115). Filter with Entity then Assignee and Apply left ["Sep 30, 2015 DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L annual return DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L entity Nadia Haddad Every 12 months","Nov 20, 2026 DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L one-off licence DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L entity Nadia Haddad One-off"], overdue first.

steps.action: Calendar step 3: Month, Previous month, Next month, Today, and back to Due-date list keep the filters
steps.expected: The Entity and Assignee filters stay in the address across each change.
steps.actual: Each change kept the filters: [["Month",true,1],["Previous month",true,null],["Next month",true,null],["Today",true,null],["Due-date list",true]]; the list again showed 2 rows.

steps.action: Calendar step 2 and recovery: Due date From and To include both dates; an end before the start shows the refusal and Apply stays unavailable
steps.expected: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-20 keeps the one-off due 2026-11-20; a reversed range shows 'End date must be on or after start date.' with Apply disabled.
steps.actual: From 2026-12-01 and To 2026-11-01 showed "End date must be on or after start date." and Apply was disabled; the editor said "Includes both dates". From 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-20 left ["Nov 20, 2026 DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L one-off licence DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C52 0928-0717 L entity Nadia Haddad One-off"].

steps.action: Calendar step 4: no results; Clear all; opening an Obligation goes to its Entity
steps.expected: An empty window shows 'No obligations match' and Clear all; the row link opens the Entity's Obligations tab.

steps.action: Home: open Obligations assigned to you; past-due items remain open and are not filed by reading
